segments.he: וְאָרוֹן עִם הַמֵּת בֶּחָצֵר. תְּנֵינָא לְהָא דְּתָנוּ רַבָּנַן: עוֹשִׂין כׇּל צוֹרְכֵי הַמֵּת. גּוֹזְזִין לוֹ שְׂעָרוֹ, וּמְכַבְּסִין לוֹ כְּסוּתוֹ, וְעוֹשִׂין לוֹ אָרוֹן מִנְּסָרִין הַמְנוּסָּרִין מֵעֶרֶב יוֹם טוֹב. רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: אַף מְבִיאִין עֵצִים וּמְנַסְּרָן בְּצִינְעָא בְּתוֹךְ בֵּיתוֹ.
segments.en: It was taught in the mishna: «And» one may also prepare «a coffin» on the intermediate days of a Festival if he is together «with the corpse in the» same «courtyard.» The Gemara comments: «We» already «learned this, as the Sages taught» in the following baraita: «One may tend to all the needs of the deceased» on the intermediate days of a Festival: «One may cut» the deceased’s «hair for him» if it was too long, «and one may wash his clothing,» i.e., his shrouds, «for him, and one may construct a coffin for him from boards that had» already «been cut from the eve of the Festival. Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: One may even bring timber and discreetly cut it» into boards «in» the privacy of «his house.»
